decided_by: owner, 2026-11-01: freeze how family-holdout results are used before the sweep; agent's choice of report-only over per-family thresholds
frozen_before: any result for no-release, timeout or nominal held out; any free-fall result; any carry-beta result on a whole family
already_seen: reports/WO-014-m1-cube-prediction-diagnosis.md: carry-contact-beta at 30 epochs, seeds 0 and 1, holding out noisy-actions, wrong-place, missed-grasp and early-release. Any threshold named now would be tuned to those results, which is why none is named.

exit_tests.ET-M1-1: unchanged and decided only by evals/M1-exit-tests.json and evals/M1-definitions.json on dev data. A family result cannot pass, fail, waive or retro-change it.
exit_tests.others: A family result is not evidence for or against any exit test.

data: the train partition only; no dev or sealed data
metric: each stream in its own units, against the lowest baseline at that horizon, with every nominal tested so far counted as a baseline

sweep.must_report: every family, joints and cube, at every horizon 1 to 10, with the worst seed, whatever the result

structure_decisions.note: These are the only decisions a family result may drive. They choose a model before any dev metric, using train data only.

contact.comparison: carry-contact-beta against carry-beta, holding out m0-scripted-missed-grasp, seeds 0, 1 and 2, 30 epochs
contact.rule: Pair by seed. One variant is better if its RMSE is lower on joint_position and on object_position at every horizon 1 to 10 on all three seeds. If carry-beta is better, it replaces carry-contact-beta. Otherwise carry-contact-beta stays, by WO-014's frozen rule.

free_fall.comparison: the variant the contact rule keeps, with and without the free-fall term, holding out m0-scripted-early-release first, seeds 0, 1 and 2, 30 epochs
free_fall.rule: Adopt the term only if both hold. (a) Its object_position RMSE on that holdout is lower at every horizon 1 to 10 on all three seeds. (b) If (a) holds, the worst value on the seed holdout, at 30 epochs, taking the worst seed, horizon and required stream, falls by at most 2 points. Reaching 20% on the family is not required, because family results are report-only.
free_fall.after_adoption: Repeat the sweep with the adopted variant and report it the same way.
